title: Watchdog warns of toxic toys in markets ahead of Christmas season

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY – An environmental watchdog has urged the Food and Drug Administration (FDA), the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI), and local governments to intensify market inspections and remove unregistered and improperly labeled children’s toys amid concerns that some products may contain hazardous chemicals. BAN Toxics raised the alarm after its recent market monitoring
